mentions.name: Broadcast
mentions.description: Self-hosted email marketing and newsletter app that lets users own their subscriber database and run the app on their own server, sending through SES, Postmark, Mailgun, or SMTP instead of being locked into a SaaS platform. Aimed at buyers who want to own their data, including those in regions with strict data privacy regulations.
mentions.problem: Email senders get locked into SaaS marketing platforms and don't own their subscriber data, which is a problem for users subject to strict data privacy regulations.
mentions.audience: Technical founders, agencies, and consultants who want a boring, controllable email tool they can deploy for themselves or clients
mentions.source_excerpt: It’s a self-hosted email marketing/newsletter app. The basic idea is: own your subscriber database, run the app on your own server, and send through SES/Postmark/Mailgun/SMTP instead of being locked into another SaaS.
